description: Single-door Direct Cool diagnostic extensions. Intended for the selected GL-D201ABCD example; verify all controls and procedures against its exact manual before deployment. Common REF issues are referenced, not duplicated.

nodes.text_en: Does this single-door model use a manual temperature-control knob?
Is the knob accidentally at OFF or at a setting outside the recommended range in the model manual?
After setting the control as described in the manual and allowing time to stabilize, is cooling normal?

diag_confirm_control_design.probable_cause: Control type is not confirmed; do not give knob-specific instructions until the exact model is verified.
diag_confirm_control_design.rag_query: single door refrigerator verify temperature control model
diag_confirm_control_design.technician_note: Confirm model number and manual before selecting a control action.

nodes.text_en: Is ice buildup affecting use or cooling on a Direct Cool cooling plate or compartment surface?
Does the exact model manual provide a user-permitted manual defrost procedure?
After defrosting exactly as directed by the manual, does normal cooling return and remain stable?

diag_defrost_manual_required.probable_cause: The approved defrost procedure is unconfirmed for this exact model.
diag_defrost_manual_required.rag_query: single door refrigerator manual defrost exact model instructions
diag_defrost_manual_required.technician_note: Do not chip ice, use sharp tools, heat the liner, or dismantle components. Confirm the manual before advising the customer.

nodes.text_en: Is frost visible on the exposed cooling plate/cooling surface of the Direct Cool refrigerator?
Does the frost appear after normal use and reduce during the model's normal defrost process, or does it remain excessive?

diag_confirm_cooling_plate.probable_cause: Cooling-plate frost behaviour requires confirmation against the exact Direct Cool model and usage conditions.
diag_confirm_cooling_plate.rag_query: Direct Cool single door refrigerator cooling plate frost model manual
diag_confirm_cooling_plate.technician_note: Do not infer refrigerant loss from visible frost alone. Check the model manual and investigate persistent abnormal frost if it affects cooling.

SDF04.title: Single-Door Tray / Chiller Placement and Internal Water

nodes.text_en: Is water pooling around a tray, chiller/fresh-food area, or underneath food containers?
Could spilled liquid, an uncovered container, or tray placement explain the water?
After cleaning and correctly reseating removable parts, has the water stopped returning?

diag_tray_water_service.probable_cause: Recurring water source is unconfirmed and requires model-specific inspection.
diag_tray_water_service.rag_query: single door Direct Cool refrigerator water around tray fresh food compartment
diag_tray_water_service.technician_note: Verify the tray arrangement and internal drainage design in the exact model manual. Do not assume all models have the same drain path.

nodes.text_en: Was the refrigerator defrosted recently using the exact model's manual-approved procedure?
After restarting as directed and allowing the recommended stabilization time, is cooling returning?

options.label: Cooling returned but frost quickly reappears

diag_recovery_service.probable_cause: Cooling recovery is incomplete after defrost; cause cannot be determined from this observation alone.
diag_recovery_service.rag_query: Direct Cool refrigerator not cooling after manual defrost restart
diag_recovery_service.technician_note: Confirm restart/stabilization instructions in the exact model manual. If cooling does not return, follow REF01 rather than assuming a particular component has failed.

runtime_notes: Ask one question at a time and use the selected option to follow next_node.
If redirect_issue is present, transfer to that issue in the common or model-specific knowledge base.
Treat conclusion.probable_cause as a provisional triage hypothesis, not a confirmed component failure.
Use only actions supported by the exact model manual; do not instruct customers to open panels, handle wiring, or work on refrigerant systems.
Internal issue IDs are ApplianceCare AI identifiers, not manufacturer error codes.
